messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to"
set: ["do not take for longer than your doctor tells you to", "take exactly as your doctor tells you to", "do not take it for longer than 14 days", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to", "never take for longer than recommended by your doctor", "take only if doctor tells you to", "do not stop taking unless doctor tells you to", "do this unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to", "do not take more than your prescribed dose", "do not use more than one dose in a 24-hour period unless your doctor tells you to", "do not change dose or stop unless doctor tells you to", "only take potassium-rich foods if doctor tells you to", "take with a meal unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "do not take more than recommended", "do not take more than prescribed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
